author: Crypto Cronkite
title: The Week Ahead: FOMC rate decision; Coinbase second-quarter results; Strategy second-quarter results
dek: What is on the calendar for the week of July 27: scheduled events only, no predictions.
key_fact: Wednesday, July 29: FOMC rate decision. The Federal Open Market Committee meets Tuesday and Wednesday; the rate decision lands Wednesday at 2:00 p.m. Eastern with a press conference at 2:30. This meeting carries no Summary of Economic Projections, so there is no dot plot to parse.
body: This is the week's known calendar: scheduled dates only, published in advance by the institutions involved. What happens at them is the week's news; this story only tells you when to watch.

Wednesday, July 29: FOMC rate decision. The Federal Open Market Committee meets Tuesday and Wednesday; the rate decision lands Wednesday at 2:00 p.m. Eastern with a press conference at 2:30. This meeting carries no Summary of Economic Projections, so there is no dot plot to parse.

Thursday, July 30: Coinbase second-quarter results. Coinbase reports second-quarter results after the U.S. market close, the largest listed crypto exchange's first report since the June market drawdown.

Thursday, July 30: Strategy second-quarter results. Strategy, the largest corporate bitcoin holder, reports second-quarter results after the close with a webinar at 5:00 p.m. Eastern; its bitcoin position marks to the quarter's prices.
